exposure: Use of ureteral stents during cesarean hysterectomy
outcome: Incidence of unintentional urinary tract injury
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with placenta accreta who underwent cesarean hysterectomy (n = 44, n = 24 ureteral stents, n = 20 no ureteral stents)
finding: The use of ureteral stents during cesarean hysterectomy in women with placenta accreta did not significantly reduce the risk of unintentional urinary tract injury.
